candidates.title: Interactive Multi-Tab Species & Customization Deck
candidates.change: Redesign the pet picker into a multi-tab choice deck that categorizes pets by species and personality traits before selection.
candidates.why: Adoption stage takes a median of 89s and mean of 1017s; structured categorization simplifies decision making and speeds up adoption.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the pick_friend screen within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Targeting high adoption dropoff with multi-tab redesign requires significant build effort.

candidates.title: Live Desktop Companion Arrival Preview Screen
candidates.change: Add a new landing preview screen before waiting that illustrates how pets spawn and dock onto the user's taskbar.
candidates.why: Users take mean 2336s on home stage, and support received 3 complaints about pets not showing up on the desktop.

new_arrival_preview.headline: Preview Your Desktop Pet Landing
new_arrival_preview.body: See how your pet sits on your taskbar and interacts with open desktop windows.

guard.reason: Adding a new preview screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses landing issues but adds an extra screen to the home sequence.

candidates.title: Account Session Pre-Verification Diagnostic Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a pre-verification check flow during sign-in that scans for existing cloud pet saves before completing login.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again, and 2 users had sign-in stalling issues.

sign_in.headline: Verify & Connect Your Pet Cloud Account
sign_in.hint: Scans and verifies cloud pet retention before confirming login.

guard.reason: Adding a diagnostic check during sign-in is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence for sign-in sync issues, but complex new diagnostic flow.

candidates.title: Welcome Story Before Path Selection Restructure
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding flow sequence to display path selection immediately following story introduction.
candidates.why: Path selection dropoff leaves overall conversion at 36.7%, and mean time spent on path choice is 514s.

guard.reason: Reordering onboarding steps is permitted as all required steps remain.

candidates.score_note: Reorders story placement to reduce initial path selection friction.

candidates.title: Existing Pet Sync Banner Notice
candidates.change: Display an informative hint banner on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that existing pets will be restored.
candidates.why: Support logged 8 messages concerning lost pets after re-authenticating.

sign_in.hint: Signing into an existing account will automatically sync and protect your previous pet data.

guard.reason: Informative copy addition to the sign-in screen complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint banner directly addresses top support complaint regarding lost pet sync.

candidates.title: Desktop Taskbar & Window Docking Guide during Waiting
candidates.change: Show interactive tips during the rendering wait screen explaining desktop pet placement and system tray visibility.
candidates.why: Mean wait screen duration is 2336s and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on screen.

guard.reason: Adding tips during the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Low cost wait screen guidance engages users during long render delays and fixes docking issues.

candidates.title: Starter Companion Perk Badge on Adoption Certificate
candidates.change: Add a visual bonus item badge reward to the adoption certificate screen upon companion naming.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is 80.2%; adding an incentive increases motivation to finish certification.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions a starter gift and bonus, violating rule 3 against mentioning gifts or free extras.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Ready System Bell Switch
candidates.change: Include an audio alert switch on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet spawn rendering finishes.
candidates.why: Users spend a mean of 2336s on the waiting screen, indicating the app is left in the background.

guard.reason: Adding a notification switch to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Audio bell alerts backgrounded users when long render wait completes.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls & System Tray Guidance Headline
candidates.change: Update final screen text to clearly direct users to the system tray and right-click menu for pet controls.
candidates.why: Finish screen conversion is 71.7% and 3 support emails asked how to control or hide pets post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet anytime or click the system tray icon to access controls, talk, or hide your companion.

guard.reason: Updating text on home_intro is an allowed onboarding change.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest dropoff step (finish 71.7%) with a simple copy update backed by support emails.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Quality Diagnostic & Preview Check
candidates.change: Insert an automated image diagnostic screen after photo upload to verify lighting and resolution before rendering.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output.

new_photo_quality_check.headline: Photo Quality Diagnostic
new_photo_quality_check.body: Checking lighting and pet face visibility for perfect rendering...

guard.reason: Adding a photo quality diagnostic screen inside onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Reduces photo rendering failures, but requires building a full diagnostic screen.
